text_block_list.text: One evening, while passing through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Trainer-chan.
Looks like they're doing something over there!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you two over there!
Why not test your love on the way back from your date?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Kyaa☆ Count me in, count me in~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Because it looked like fun! A-n-d besides~..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
With Maya and Trainer's love, the grand prize is totally guaranteed!
Right, right?♪
...There appears to be no correlation between luck and love, however.

Swept up in Mayano Top Gun's momentum,
we went shopping in the shopping district
and decided to try our luck at the lottery.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan! We've only got one raffle ticket!
That means just one shot, so make it count!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Please, please,
let me win the grand prize~...!

Saying our prayers together,
we gripped the lever side by side and spun the raffle wheel.
And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo~~!!
Mission complete~~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Well then,
time to take off for the hot springs☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~? Preparations~?

However, in reality, heading out right now
requires more than just packing our bags.
I should adjust her future race and training schedule before going—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: For Maya?
choice_data_list: Because I want to make your goal come true.
Because I want to make your goal come true.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. You know, Maya went and
decided on this year's goal♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I promise I'll... surpass that person...
I'll surpass Brian-san at her absolute best!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Alright, decided! Then,
let's go once Maya reaches her goal!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: In that case, will you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yay! Then it's settled!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, let's relax a whooole lot
and have a ton of fun!

Looking forward to the day they could use the hot springs ticket
became a joy shared between the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah! First prize!
Yaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wait, this isn't a hot spring trip ticket~~?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
“Still~, Maya wanted to go on a lovey-dovey trip
with Trainer-chan, y'know...?”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmm... A hamburger steak isn't enough to capture Trainer-chan's heart, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ? Are you not, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Then, then,
Maya can even share her hamburger steak with you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Well?
Did you fall even more in love with Maya?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Haha, look at you two lovebirds!
Alright, I'll throw in one more hamburg steak on the house!
Eat up, you two!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wah!! Thank you, mister!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, they said we're a sizzling couple~!
Doesn't that make things feel waaaay more lovey-dovey?♪
That night, Mayano Top Gun and I enjoyed a special carrot hamburg steak together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hyawaa!? A mountain of carrots~?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Take all the carrots
in that basket over there home with ya!

—Looking in the direction the shopkeeper pointed,
there sat a massive basket packed full of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if Maya can finish all of this.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
! Really?!
In that case, Trainer-chan and I—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp?!
Maya just had a great idea!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Trainer-chan.
Would it be okay if we kept this carrot in your room?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya shares a room with Teio-chan, so
it might be too cramped! So, y'know, right!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then starting tomorrow, Maya will come by your room
and make loooots of carrot dishes for you♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, with Maya's home-cooked meal,
you'll fall head over heels for me~♪
—From that day on, the number of times Mayano Top Gun barged into my room only increased...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehhー!? No way, no wayー!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mister, you must have meant the grand prize, right?
Right? Pleeease?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Looks like third prize.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! And here I was planning to go
on a hot springs trip with Trainer-chan~...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And for it to be just a single carrot...
choice_data_list: It's the same vibrant color as Mayano's hair.
It's the same vibrant color as Mayano's hair, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Trainer-chan,
you think about Maya way too much~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Saying Maya's hair color is carrot-colored.
Like anyone would think of that right away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe♪

And Mayano Top Gun flashed
a vibrant, bubbly smile.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I was de-finitely sure it'd hit!
I mean, come on~!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya and Trainer-chan are
sooo lovey-dovey like this, you know?
Right~?

I reiterate: there shouldn't be any correlation between luck and love.
After soothing a sulking Mayano Top Gun,
we returned to the academy...
